Zero-shot iPet clearly outperforms the unsupervised baselines for all datasets (L3 vs L1); on AG's News, it even performs better than standard supervised training with 1000 examples (L3 vs L13).

As we increase the training set size, the performance gains of Pet and iPet become smaller, but for both 50 and 100 examples, Pet continues to considerably outperform standard supervised training (L8 vs L7, L11 vs L10) with iPet (L9, L12) still giving consistent improvements.
We see that the auxiliary task is extremely valuable when training on just 10 examples.
